// diagnostic

E0743

Dynamic call `{trait_name}.{method}` has no effect bound.

What

Dynamic call `{trait_name}.{method}` has no effect bound.

Why

A trait value can select any implementation at runtime, and the program holds none of this method to bound the call, so an enclosing effect ceiling needs the trait method's declared row or a ceiling in the trait's `#FX(…)` cap.

Fix

Declare an effect row on the trait method, such as `-[]>` for pure dispatch, put an `#FX(…)` ceiling above the trait, or move the dynamic call outside the bounded function.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0743: Tests/UI/Ownership/open_dynamic_trait_view_dispatch_is_rejected.stderr.

Error [jet.ViewOutlivesOwner]: Returned views need a stable owner relationship
  --> open_dynamic_trait_view_dispatch_is_rejected.jet:6:21
    |
  6 |     return selector.select(left, right)
    |                     ^^^^^^
 Why: Each public `View`/`ViewMut` slot must name a bounded set of receiver, parameter, or static sources that stay live; this return did not prove those sources
 Fix: Return a view derived from parameters or the receiver on every path, keep the view local, or return an owned copy with `.copy()`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2305
